title: הלילה שבו השעה אחת וחצי קרתה פעמיים
summary: The night Israel's clocks went back (25 Oct 2026, 02:00 IDT → 01:00 IST) so 01:00–02:00 happened twice; Peterson twins (Cape Cod, 6 Nov 2016: Samuel 1:39, Ronan 31 min later recorded 1:10); UTC; solar noon = highest sun, shortest shadow — Zikhron Ya'akov today 05:52/11:24/16:57, sun ~45° so a 1 m stick casts ~1 m; Earth turns 15°/h = 4 min per degree; railway time 18 Nov 1883 'day of two noons', 1884 Meridian Conference (26 nations, 22–1–2); Israel's time by 30°E (≈Alexandria), Zikhron ~20 min early; equation of time (+16 min now, −14 in Feb; ellipse + tilt; analemma); China one zone since 1949, Kashgar noon ~14:40; DST history: Franklin satire 1784, Hudson 1895 (insects, 2 h), Willett 1907 (80 min), Germany/Austria-Hungary 30 Apr 1916, Mandate Palestine 1940, Knesset rule 2013; energy savings disputed (~0.3%).
reviewer_verdict: PASS (2 rounds) — nits left: ~30 min with the test (visible words incl. UI ≈1,570 younger / ≈1,840 older); Arto tip briefly covers the night canvas on phones (template); globe city names are in numbered readouts under the canvas, not on it
